text: easin_id Integer. EASIN Species ID(s). scientific_name Character. Scientific name(s) part(s) . Case insensitive. environment Character. Environment type(s): one : "MAR", "FRW", "TER", "OLI" filter species , marine, freshwater, terrestrial oligohaline environments respectively. Use environments() look list environment codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. country_code Character. Countries' ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code(s) filter species Member State concern. Use countries() look list country codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. states submitted species Member State concern EASIN. region_code Character. Species Outermost regions concern codes defined NUTS (Nomenclature territorial units statistics). Use regions() look list region codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. impact Character. Species impact(s). One : "hi" (high) "lo" (low).  Use impacts() look list impact codes meaning. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. taxon Character named vector taxon name(s) named taxonomic rank(s). Use ranks() look list valid ranks. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. taxonomy Character named vector taxonomic names named taxonomic rank. Provide right order kingdom family. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. present_in_country Character. One countries' ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes filter species present countries. Use countries() look list country codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. status Character. Species status code(s). One :  "", "C" "Q". Use statuses() look list status codes meaning. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. horizon Logical. TRUE, returns species coming Horizon Scanning assessments. TRUE allowed. partly_native Logical. TRUE, returns species native one EU countries. native_in_country Character. One countries' ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes filter species native countries. Use countries() look list country codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. union_concern Logical. TRUE, returns species Union concern. TRUE allowed. limit Integer. Maximum number rows return. Default: NULL (return rows).
